property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, the reference C.transfer(...) always returns true (it ignores low-level call return values and only reverts on empty _tos), whereas the mutant can return false if any individual low-level call returns false — so there exist inputs (a mix of callees that succeed and one that returns false) where the mutant returns false while the reference still returns true.
change_summary: After each call, if any call returns false, immediately return false (short-circuit), changing return behavior when some calls fail but do not revert.
